features.name: Jobs with an orphaned grandchild
features.description: A grandchild holding the output pipe leaves the job running: _watch's pipe.close() blocks on a reader, and cancel/timeout cannot reach the orphan. Finish the job without blocking and kill the leftover processes.

steps.title: Finish jobs whose pipes an orphan holds

features.notes: Two causes: _collect used text read(65536), which waits for 64 KB or EOF, and _watch closed pipes a reader was blocked on. Readers now use buffer.read1 and update the sink as they go, _watch skips closing pipes of live readers, kill_tree reaches orphans on POSIX (killpg after the leader exits). Windows: taskkill /T cannot find children of a dead parent, so an orphan is left running (job still finishes, output kept); a Windows Job Object would fix that, not done.
